images.caption: Looking down the Duwamish River from a micro-park. along the Green River Trail, across Interurban Avenue from the Tukwila Park and Ride, near the corner of South 56th Street. images.filename: 1985 time capsule at Foster, Tukwila, Washington.jpg
images.caption: Time capsule in 1985 bridge that carries South 56th Street over the Duwamish River near historic Foster Landing and Foster Station, Tukwila, Washington. Foster Landing was used by 19th century riverboats, Foster Station by the Interurban (the Puget Sound Electric Railway). This is just off the Green River Trail, across Interurban Avenue from the Tukwila Park and Ride.
images.alt: Time capsule in 1985 bridge that carries South 56th Street over the Duwamish River near historic Foster Landing and Foster Station, Tukwila, Washington. Foster Landing was used by 19th century riverboats, Foster Station by the Interurban (the Puget Sound Electric Railway). This is just off the Green River Trail, across Interurban Avenue from the Tukwila Park and Ride.

images.filename: Black River Junction plaque at Fort Dent.jpg
images.caption: A plaque along the Green River Trail in Fort Dent Park, Tukwila, Washington, memorializing 19th century riverboat service. This was the Black River Junction, where the Green River (then White River) and Black River met to form the Duwamish River.
images.alt: A plaque along the Green River Trail in Fort Dent Park, Tukwila, Washington, memorializing 19th century riverboat service. This was the Black River Junction, where the Green River (then White River) and Black River met to form the Duwamish River.
